    Connection(int d, int r, int f, int c) : destination(d), reverse_index(r), current_flow(f), max_capacity(c) {}
};

vector<Connection> network[MAX_SIZE];
int level[MAX_SIZE], next_edge[MAX_SIZE], source_node, sink_node;

void connect_nodes(int from, int to, int capacity, int reverse_capacity = 0) {
    network[from].emplace_back(to, (int)network[to].size(), 0, capacity);
    network[to].emplace_back(from, (int)network[from].size() - 1, 0, reverse_capacity);
}

bool compute_levels() {
    fill(level, level + MAX_SIZE, -1);
    level[source_node] = 0;
    queue<int> q;
    q.push(source_node);
    while (!q.empty() && level[sink_node] == -1) {
        int u = q.front(); q.pop();
        for (const auto& conn : network[u]) {
            int v = conn.destination;
            if (level[v] == -1 && conn.current_flow < conn.max_capacity) {
                level[v] = level[u] + 1;
                q.push(v);
            }
        }
    }
    return level[sink_node] != -1;
}

int push_flow(int node, int bottleneck) {
    if (node == sink_node || !bottleneck) return bottleneck;
    for (int& i = next_edge[node]; i < (int)network[node].size(); ++i) {
        auto& conn = network[node][i];
        int next_node = conn.destination;
        if (level[next_node] != level[node] + 1) continue;
        int augment = push_flow(next_node, min(bottleneck, conn.max_capacity - conn.current_flow));

            conn.current_flow += augment;
            network[next_node][conn.reverse_index].current_flow -= augment;
            return augment;
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

    int total = 0;
    while (compute_levels()) {
        fill(next_edge, next_edge + MAX_SIZE, 0);
        int augment;

            total += augment;
        }
    }

}
